description: Starts the workflow for the specified item. When executed, it will set the state to the initial state and clear all workflow history

StartWorkflowInput.description: Represents the input for starting a workflow.

item.description: The target item for the workflow.

database.description: The name of the database where item exits.

existingVersionOnly.description: Indicates whether to return the item even if the requested version does not exist.

itemId.description: The item ID. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

path.description: The full item path. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

requirePresentation.description: DEPRECATED. Indicates whether the item required must have presentation.

version.description: The version number of the item.
